## SecurityConfigOptions.legacyDefaults property

One-shot rollback switch for 4.3.0: restore pre-4.3 (loose) defaults. Removed in 5.0.0 (ADR-103). When enabled, startup prints a WARN listing every reverted item.

**Signature:**

```typescript
legacyDefaults?: boolean;
```
